desc.Input: Graph entry: declares the input tensor shape (batch size excluded); the shape follows the selected dataset.
desc.Output: Graph exit: checks the last dim matches the class count (classification) or is any width (regression). It never alters the tensor.
desc.Linear: Fully connected layer: maps the last dim to out_features — the usual classification head or a dimension change.
desc.Activation: Element-wise nonlinearity (ReLU / GELU / Tanh …) that lets the network fit nonlinear relations.
desc.Flatten: Flattens everything after start_dim; the usual step before feeding conv features into a Linear layer.
desc.Dropout: Randomly zeroes activations with probability p while training to curb overfitting; it is a no-op at inference.
desc.Conv2d: 2D convolution: sliding windows extract local spatial features; channels, kernel, stride and padding are tunable.
desc.MaxPool2d: Max pooling: downsamples by taking the max in each window, keeping the strongest responses.
desc.AvgPool2d: Average pooling: downsamples by averaging each window, giving smoother outputs than max pooling.
desc.AdaptiveAvgPool2d: Adaptive average pooling: squashes any spatial size to a fixed output_size; 1 means global average pooling.
desc.BatchNorm2d: Normalizes 4D feature maps (N,C,H,W) per channel to speed up convergence; typically between conv and activation.
desc.BatchNorm1d: Normalizes (N,C) or (N,C,L) tensors per feature; used for fully connected and sequence features.
desc.LayerNorm: Normalizes along the last dim, independent of batch size — the standard norm inside Transformers.
desc.Embedding: Looks up integer token ids as dense vectors; the entry point of text and sequence models.
desc.PositionalEncoding: Injects position information (learned or sinusoidal) because attention alone cannot tell order.
desc.LSTM: Recurrent layer: walks the sequence step by step keeping a memory state; can be bidirectional and return all steps or just the last.
desc.MultiHeadAttention: Multi-head self-attention: aggregates information within the sequence by relevance; with the causal mask each position only sees the left.
desc.ResidualAdd: Residual sum: adds two same-shaped inputs element-wise, the building block of skip connections.
desc.Concat: Concatenates several inputs along one dim (other dims must match); used to fuse branches.
